claims.text: Patient reports being allergic to ibuprofen, causing wheezing.

citations.quote: I think I am allergic to ibuprofen, it makes me wheezy.

open_questions: When was the ibuprofen allergy first recorded?
Has the patient had any prior respiratory reactions to NSAIDs or other medications?
Was any action taken in response to this reported allergy, such as documenting in allergy list or stopping prescriptions?
Which medications were started, stopped, held or changed?
Which follow-ups, referrals or tests are planned or outstanding?

citation.quote: I think I am allergic to ibuprofen, it makes me wheezy.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Respiratory reaction (wheezing) to ibuprofen suggests possible NSAID-exacerbated respiratory disease or IgE-mediated allergy; high risk of recurrence with re-exposure.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Formally document ibuprofen as a confirmed allergy in the allergy list and flag for NSAID cross-reactivity.
